title: Information Manager
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€6.500,60 - €10.389,47
The Information Manager is responsible for continuous improvement by developing, innovating and safeguarding knowledge within the team. The Information Manager is responsible by having up-to-date process documentation, (internal) guidelines, training materials, process and data quality performance insights. The focus is on enhancing process effectiveness through a data-driven mindset, which can ultimately lead to improved efficiency, as well as greater satisfaction for both customers and employees. Additionally, the power of analytics must be used to make sure procurement teams can work with required and relevant information for data driven decision-making.
Your responsibilities
Operations and Analytics
Identify creation of relevant data and analytics and support the implementation and maintenance of reporting such as KPIs.
Support procurement teams by providing analytical insights to help them develop their category strategy, sourcing strategy, and supplier segmentation model.
Work with Tech, COO Finance and Data teams to implement data and analytics requirements from procurement keeping a close eye on data integrity and data quality.
Support generation of analytics, metrics and mechanisms to monitor and measure supplier performance and success. Including assessing opportunities for supplier and market innovation trends.
Manage the review of vendor master data to ensure its accuracy and completeness.
Work closely with Procurement operations to secure back-office efficiency and improvements.
Analyse data to identify trends and assess risks, which involves interpreting complex information and making informed decisions.
Prepare Change Requests and ensure business implementation for (procurement) application improvements.
Stakeholder Management
Alignment with multidisciplinary Subject Matter Experts to ascertain efficient and effective process while adhering to internal and external requirements in procurement processes (Source to Contract, Purchase to Pay).
Embed collaboration with multiple Subject Matter Experts, including global/local procurement teams to implement effective and efficient end-to-end procurement processes serving multiple subject matter experts (Legal, CISO, DPO, etc.) and ascertaining high data quality levels. The challenge is not only building the capabilities in alignment with Global direction but also embedding the usage and application thereof within locations.
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
Furthermore, you have:
6+ years in Procurement area, preferably at a strategic level in an international (financial services provider) organisation
Procurement Operations knowledge/experience
Data science and data analytics acumen
Process improvement/continuous improvement skills
Experience working with offshore teams
Analytical and data science skills
Quality and process orientation, ideally process improvement skillset such as a blackbelt
Agile and self-driven
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditionshere.
